description: This file contains unit tests for the ToolResultTextFormatter class, verifying its ability to format and summarize JSON data and plain text results related to a tool named 'nodes'.

classes.name: ToolResultTextFormatterTests
classes.description: A test suite struct containing various test cases to validate the behavior of ToolResultTextFormatter.

methods.name: leavesPlainTextUntouched
methods.description: Tests that plain text input remains unchanged after formatting.

methods.name: summarizesNodesListJSON
methods.description: Tests that a JSON list of nodes is summarized correctly into a descriptive string.

methods.name: summarizesErrorJSONAndDropsAgentPrefix
methods.description: Tests that an error JSON message is summarized correctly, removing agent prefix information.

methods.name: suppressesUnknownStructuredPayload
methods.description: Tests that unrecognized JSON structures produce an empty string.
